profile.headline: Sr Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
•	Over 12+ Years of IT Experience in the core areas of Leading, Managing, Analysis, Design, Development, Coding, Testing and Maintenance/ Implementation of Commercial Software.  
•	Extensive experience in design and development of n-tier large web-based distributed systems.
•	Excellent communication, inter-personnel and team player skills
•	Experienced in building, leading, training and energizing large team located across USA and abroad to have continuous development around the clock. Also created Dev-ops culture among team to optimize team output.
•	Teamwork to accomplish business Engineering, Integration, Deployment and Maintenance of e-business systems. 
•	Experienced in motivating team and bring culture of innovation to enhance product and explore new sources of revenue.  
•	Hands on experience in building Microservices by creating and publishing SOAP & REST Web Services and restructuring application into smaller automatable units. 
Languages	: Golang, Java/J2EE (Servlets, JSP, EJB, JDBC, JNDI, JMS, JSF, Web Services), J2ME, C, C++, XML, SQL, PL/SQL, UML
Script Languages	: Java Script, VB Script, Shell Script
Web/App Server	: BEA WebLogic 8.1/10/12, IBM Web Sphere, JBoss
Framework	: Struts, Hibernate, Spring, JUnit, PUBSUB, Spring webflow, Microservices, REST
Database	: Oracle, Postgre Sql, MYSQL, MS Access, Mongo DB
Operating System	: Windows, Linux, UNIX, Mac OS
Dev ops	: Jenkins, Ringbuild, Jira, Confluence, Maven, Grunt, Gulp
Other	: MS Visio, Apache Tomcat, Fortify Security Scan,Jenkins, Ringbuild, Node.js, NPM, Docker

positions.title: Full Stack IT Manager, Solution Architect
positions.description:
•	Establishing SDLC best practices in crossfunctional teams for achieving organic and maintainable growth of product and company
•	Involved in the complete lifecycle of product establishment from proof of concept to production delivery. 
•	Establishing single sign-on between multiple applications
•	Conversion of monolithic applications to Microservices.
•	Service Monitoring using AppDynamics and Splunk
•	Dashboarding of the application using various tools.
•	Used Docker-swarm to build and scale applications. 
•	Build automated builds and deploy using Jenkins to support CI/CD
•	Building proof of concept and mentoring team to achieve production delivery.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff Level IV
positions.description:
•	Maintain and re-energize Verizon Wireless's B2B Portal
•	Engage in research and analysis in designing, developing and architecture of future products
•	Build Push to talk from ground zero and make it stable within 6 months
•	Work with senior management and executive staff to develop cohesive plans for the development of innovative software products.
•	Lead planning and execution of project work plans, making ongoing revisions to meet changing needs.
•	Lead planning and execution of project work plans, making ongoing revisions to meet changing needs.
•	Directed, coached and inspired a team of 10+ developers to consistently produce high quality software without missing a single implementation date for the past 4 years 
•	Collaborate with cross functional teams in global locations to build software architectures that resolve complex business problems.
•	Oversee solutions development initiatives utilizing input from consultants and technology vendors.
•	Used various modules of Spring frameworks like core, ORM, web, web mvc etc., for developing loosely coupled and lightweight application.
•	Improved software quality by significantly reducing the defect backlog from hundreds to less than 30 visible defects at software implementation date.
•	Prepared build scripts using Maven, Grunt, Gulp and Ant for various projects and automated using Jenkins.
•	Hibernate is used as persistent at middle tire for providing object model over relational data model.
•	Involved in creating JMS Server configuration and worked with point to point and publish/subscribe messaging paradigms.
•	Created connection factories, Queues, topics and coded Message Driven Beans (MDBs) as subscribers for distributed destinations (Topics and Queues).
•	Developed web tire using JSP, Java Script, DHTML, HTML which reflect Business requirements.  Also used velocity for generating reports for account, billing, orders etc.,

positions.title: Sr Software Developer (Non Employee)
positions.description:
•	Developed presentation tier using JSP, Struts and Struts2 framework.
•	Used Core Spring framework for dependency injection and Spring Context to add support for message sources and i18n internationalization.
•	Used Spring ORM to integrate with the Hibernate and used the hibernate template to implement the business logic.
•	Wrote spring configuration file to define beans, define data source and hibernate properties.
•	Used Spring DAO on the Data access layer with the Hibernate.
•	Wrote the promos rules for personal auto and water craft line of business. 
•	Developed business logic using Java, Struts Action classes and deployed using Tomcat. 
•	Validated users input using regular expressions in JavaScript as well as in the server side 
•	Created Database Tables, Sequences and wrote hibernate mapping files and POJO classes. 
•	Used AJAX for better user interface and to load some fields values from the database.
•	Used DB2 and Postgre SQL as Databases and wrote SQL queries for updating and inserting data into the tables.
•	Used Struts tag libraries and custom tag libraries extensively while coding JSP pages.
•	Developed ant build script and ant task classes to clean, compile, copy, deploy, generate configuration files using filters, doc, jar and war files. 
•	Involved in the documentation of the application.
•	Fixed the defects in the existing systems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Organized and prioritized projects as well as coordinated with stakeholders to define 3-5 year road map.
•	Developed coding standards, test plans and review processes.
•	Direct development team efforts to achieve team and product development goals, objectives and milestones.
•	Analyze and review requirements software specification and generating flow diagram, sequence diagram and class diagram.  
•	Worked on TDD (Test Driven Development) a type of Agile development methodology.     
•	Used Spring Web MVC at web tire of application to provide MVC framework.    
•	Used web flow 2.0 to provide control flow in application.  Used hibernate as persistent to provide object model over relational data model.  
•	Also used hibernate annotation for object to relational mapping (ORM).    Consumed web services for user management and user administration purpose.      
•	Wrote unit test for various development module throughout the application for test driven development (TDD) approach.    
•	Used JSP, apache tiles, CSS for interface design.  Also extensively used Spring tags for UI development.
•	Used websphere as application server.

positions.title: Sr Software Analyst
positions.description:
•	Thorough analysis of application for migrating it from web sphere to Jboss and from jdk 1.3 to jdk 1.5. 
•	To create new functionalities from the scratch for southeast region wrote batch processes to implement business rules.
•	Used Spring core to implement Inversion of Control by adding dependency injection throughout the project.
•	Involved writing Stored Procedures in pl/sql and calling them from java code and optimize the performance. 
•	Used Direct JDBC in Some places for database operations and calling the Stored Procedure. 
•	Used Hibernate Query Language(HQL) to store and retrieve data from the database.
•	Wrote client side validations using JavaScript also some level of validation is done using AJAX. 
•	Wrote JavaScript and handled asynchronous request and response using AJAX. 
•	Developed application using ANT on JBoss application server.

positions.title: Tech center specialiest and Research Project Developer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for to develop application from scratch.
•	Thorough analysis of circuit city web site for designing of intended application.
•	Used MySQL database and define relations and schemas for application
•	Wrote and customized several Java programs for the generation of filtering, sorting and searching through large number of products.
•	Used design patterns MVC, Business Object.
•	Application development with Eclipse and Jboss application server.
•	Designed and developed User Interfaces and menus using HTML, Java and javascript.

positions.title: J2Ee Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed web tire of an application using struts framework to impalement MVC design patterns.
•	Developed presentation tier using JSP, HTML and struts tag libraries such as tiles and HTML.
•	Responsible in creating Action classes which route submittals to appropriate business logic module.
•	Developed session EJBs on business tier to accomplish the business logic.
•	Involved in creating JMS Server configuration and worked with point to point and publish/subscribe messaging paradigms.
•	Created connection factories, Queues, topics and coded Message Driven Beans (MDBs) as subscribers for distributed destinations (Topics and Queues).
•	Used hibernate as persistence. 
•	Used Oracle as a database and implemented JDBC connectivity to make a connection to Oracle.
•	Involved in system data analysis, design and implemented on Oracle and optimized system performance by modifying indexes and stored procedures.
•	Exposed business functionalities to external system via Web Services by using SOAP(Simple Object Access Protocol).
•	Developed ANT build script to deploy the application on WebLogic server.
•	Used Log4j for logging and JUnit for unit testing.
•	Used CVS as a version control system for managing source code.

company.name: Nirma Institute Of Technology (Web I Technologies)

positions.title: J2Ee Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed front end of an application using struts framework to implement MVC design pattern.
•	Developed presentation tier using JSP, HTML and Java Standard tag library.
•	Wrote client side validations using JavaScript.
•	Developed action class interacting with EJBs using DAO design pattern.
•	Developed session EJBs on business tier to accomplish the business logic and deployed on Weblogic server.
•	Used postgrace as a database and implemented JDBC connectivity to make a connection to the database.
•	Developed DAOs to manage connection with database and to encapsulate all access to the database. 
•	Wrote new and modified existing SQL queries to store and retrieve data to and from the database more efficiently 
•	Used ClearCase as a project configuration management for managing source code version.

positions.title: Linux GTK Developer
positions.description:
•	Design and code application for linux 7.2.
•	Used C and C++ concepts to develop an application
•	Used GTK2.0 library to provide GUI
•	Used postgrace as a relational database.
•	For cross compiling application we used arm-linux-toolchain
